records.text: John greeted James and asked James what motivates him.
James told John that video games give James joy and excitement and keep James motivated.
John told James that John is a big video game fan and that video games help John relax after a long day.
John asked James what game James is currently enjoying the most.
James is currently really into the video game The Witcher 3 and finds its story and atmosphere amazing.
James asked John whether John had tried The Witcher 3.
John has not played The Witcher 3 yet, but has heard it is awesome and plans to give it a go.
John signed up for a programming class on 2022-03-17.
John asked James whether James had ever done any programming.
James thinks programming is an awesome skill.
James tried programming once in college and now programming is all his life.
James wished John good luck in John's programming class and asked John whether John had any coding experience.
John did a bit of coding in HTML and CSS a few years before 2022.
John plans to refresh his HTML and CSS skills in the programming class.
John asked James which programming languages James likes most and what projects James has done.
James has worked with Python and C++.
James has built a website and created some game mods.
James shared a photo of a computer screen showing a video game scene as one example of a game mod he created.
John thinks James's mod looks amazing and its graphics are awesome.
John asked James what other programming languages James has worked with.
James has not worked with any programming languages other than Python and C++, but hopes to work with more in the future.
John proposed that he and James develop mobile applications together in the future, and asked whether James likes the idea.
James shared a photo of two dogs tied to a fence with a leash during his conversation with John.
John asked James the names of his pets and his plans for the dog walking app.
James has two dogs named Max and Daisy.
James plans to build an app for dog walking and pet care; the goal is to connect pet owners with reliable dog walkers and provide helpful information on pet care.
John believes James's dog walking app would find a lot of buyers.
James says the personal touch sets his dog walking app apart: users can add their pup's preferences/needs, making it unique for each owner and pup.
James shared a photo of a notepad with a handwritten note during his conversation with John.
John thinks James's dog walking app idea is great and that James's pup will love it.
John asked James what motivates him to work on programming projects.
James says creating something and seeing it come to life gives him a great sense of accomplishment; he writes all his goals in a notebook and finds it very satisfying to check each one off when done.
On 2022-03-17 James shared a photo of a person holding a notebook containing a list of things.

James is working on a project he has wanted to do since he was a kid: as a child he drew sketches of the main character and made comics, and now he wants to turn it into a computer game; the project has him really excited.
On 2022-03-17 James shared a photo of a drawing of a girl in a plane, related to his childhood game concept.
James says he is always excited to combine his favorite passions, gaming and storytelling, and enjoys creating his own project, bringing his ideas to life, and the challenge of it.
John finds James's project of combining his passions to create something new really fulfilling and exciting and says he can't wait to see the outcome.
On 2022-03-17 John shared a photo of a medical chart with instructions for a procedure.
James plans to keep John updated on his computer game project and may invite John to help with some things in the game because of John's HTML knowledge.
John says it will be great to work with James on his game project.
On 2022-03-16 James went bowling and got 2 strikes.
James loves bowling.

John does not like bowling itself and says he can't share James's love for it because his fingers are too big; he mentions he perhaps should take up exercise and at least start going for a run in the morning.
James says it's a pity John doesn't like bowling and that it would be nice to go play with him one day.
John suggests he and James do something other than bowling, such as playing slot machines and arcades.
The last time James played at slot machines he was so engrossed in the game that he did not notice his wallet being taken out of his pocket; he calls it a sad story.
John apologized to James about the stolen wallet story and joked that he will be nearby to look after James's pockets.
John suggested he and James try VR gaming together, describing it as pretty immersive.
James has tried VR gaming and says it's crazy how real it feels; he asked John if he had tried it.
John has tried VR gaming a few times and says it's insane how immersive the experience can be; he can't wait to try it together with James.
James and John agreed to try VR gaming together on Saturday 2022-03-19.
James thinks VR gaming is awesome.
James created a game avatar and joined a new gaming platform, where he enjoys exploring and chatting with other gamers.
James feels like part of a super cool online gaming community and finds joining the new platform a whole new adventure.
James has been connecting with other gamers, sharing tips, strategies, and stories about gaming.
James thinks gaming brings people together regardless of their backgrounds and is a shared language and passion.
James says gaming has been a refuge for him in tough times; games are his go-to when feeling overwhelmed, like therapy, letting him relax, forget his troubles, and get lost in another world.
John says gaming helps him escape stress and calms him down during tough times.
James has lately been checking out different styles (genres) of gaming to try something fresh and test himself in other ways.
John has recently started a new hobby: he bought a metal detector and walks along the beaches looking for something worthwhile.
James asked John whether he had already found anything interesting with his metal detector.
John has found mostly bottle caps, a couple of coins, and once a gold ring while metal detecting.
On 2022-03-20, James wished John good luck with his metal detecting.
On 2022-03-20, James told John he has something to show him.
On 2022-03-20, John asked James to show what he has.

On 2022-03-20 James shared a photo with John of his two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouths, calling them his best buds having a blast in the park and saying they've brought so much joy to his life.
James's two dogs can do tricks: sit, stay, paw, and rollover; James has done lots of training with them and says they picked it up fast.
On 2022-03-20 James shared a photo with John of his dog Daisy laying on a bed with a name tag, waiting for a treat.
James considers his dogs Max and Daisy like his family and the best pals ever; they bring him love and companionship.
John finds James's dogs adorable and thinks pets are the best and make life much better; John wants a pet badly but does not have one yet, hoping to someday.
James offered to help John find the perfect pet, saying John would make a great pet parent; John thanked him, said he'd keep it in mind, and appreciated the offer.
John had a big win in his video game the week before 2022-03-27, finally advancing to the next level, which he described as a huge confidence booster and felt like a real achievement.
James is learning to play the drums as a new instrument, which he describes as quite the journey and a way of challenging himself.
James shared a photo of a drum kit featuring a white drum and a black drum.
John also plays drums and shared a photo of his drum kit sitting on top of a table.
John has been playing drums for about a month as of 2022-03-27 (started around late February 2022); he finds it tough but fun.
James started learning drums a few days before 2022-03-27 (around 2022-03-23), practices daily, and is seeing improvements; he finds it tough but rewarding.

James got a new cutting-edge gaming system with incredible graphics and has been playing all kinds of new games; he finds gaming a great way to relax after work and to connect with friends who share his passion for gaming.
Since last speaking with James (after 2022-03-20), John attended a gaming convention where he tried out many games, met developers, and took part in a tournament, which he found amazing.
John shared a photo of a crowded convention hall with a large crowd of people from the gaming convention he attended.
John competed in an intense CS:GO (Counter-Strike: Global Offensive) tournament at the gaming convention; CS:GO is his favorite game.
John found it awesome to watch all the skilled CS:GO players competing at the convention, and it inspired him to improve his own gaming skills.
John is always looking to improve his gaming and hit new goals, and says the same commitment applies to his hobbies and other activities.
James stays motivated and focused by setting small goals and tracking his progress.
James is getting into different types of games, such as RPGs and strategy games, and is excited to explore these new genres.
James promised to keep John updated on his gaming adventures with the new genres (RPGs and strategy games).

James joined an online gaming tournament on 2022-04-03; it was intense and fun, he made it to the semifinals and won some rounds, but did not make it through the final rounds, which were tough and close.
James's favourite game is Apex Legends, which he plays with his team; he describes it as intense with awesome graphics and super fast-paced gameplay that stands out among other games.
James shared a screenshot of his Apex Legends character and a photo of his team's game screen showing robots while discussing Apex Legends.

At the online gaming tournament, James met the whole professional team; he did not get a photo with them, but one team member gave him a couple of gaming tips and the whole team gave him autographs, which made him very happy.
The gaming advice James remembers most is that you always need to communicate correctly with your team and never put your ego above team success.
James usually communicates with his team using voice chat because it is fast and helps them work together effectively.
James is looking forward to competing in the next online gaming tournament.
James is thinking of trying new game genres, specifically RPGs and MOBAs, and will tell John his thoughts once he tries them.

James shared a photo report of the tournament: a group of people posing for a picture, a man in a costume standing in front of a sign, a man in a costume holding a sword, a man sitting in a chair playing a video game, a notepad with a pen and a glass of water, a group of people standing around a table, and a video game cover.
John thinks communication and teamwork are super important in gaming, and that games like RPGs and MOBAs can be awesome for engaging stories or epic multiplayer fights.

On 2022-04-04 at 2:13 pm, John ended the conversation with James, saying: 'Let me know how it goes. Stay safe. Talk to you soon. Bye!' He asked James to let him know how it goes (likely about James trying RPGs and MOBAs) and to stay safe.

On 2022-04-12, James told John that he adopted a puppy from a shelter in Stamford in the week of 2022-04-04 to 2022-04-10 and named the puppy Ned; James said his days have been happier with Ned in the family.
On 2022-04-12, James shared a photo with John of a dog and a cat sitting on a dog bed.
On 2022-04-12, John told James that he has not made much progress with gaming lately because life has been busy with work, but gaming makes him happy and is a good way to forget life's stresses.
On 2022-04-12, James agreed with John that gaming helps forget life's stresses and said it is like heading into another world.
On 2022-04-12, John told James that he is playing a new RPG with a really cool story and world, describing it as being transported to a futuristic dystopia.
On 2022-04-12, John shared a photo with James of a city at night with a view of the city, related to the new RPG.
On 2022-04-12, James asked John if he would like the new RPG and said he is always up for trying new games.
On 2022-04-12, John told James that James will love the new RPG because it has a fun story, an awesome world, and tough gameplay, but the game is a little laggy and sometimes produces errors.
On 2022-04-12, John shared a photo with James of a computer screen showing a game error; John said he encountered that error on 2022-04-11.
On 2022-04-12, James said the game must still be raw and that he would rather wait until the bugs are completely fixed before trying it.

On 2022-04-12, John told James that even with minor bugs the new RPG still looks great, has awesome graphics, and has super immersive gameplay, and John recommended that James try it now; John offered to send a link.
On 2022-04-12, John and James made a plan: John will send James a link to the new RPG, and James will check it out and tell John what he thinks afterward.
On 2022-04-12, James said he is excited to give John's recommended new RPG a try.
On 2022-04-12, John and James ended their chat with goodbyes and wishes to take care.
On 2022-04-19 (last Tuesday), John met three cool new friends in his programming course who share the same passion as him, and he was glad to grow his social circle.

On 2022-04-14 (last Thursday), James worked with one of his gaming pals on a programming project, combining programming and gaming to create a virtual world inspired by Witcher 3; seeing their ideas come to life was awesome.
On 2022-04-20, John shared a photo of a video game screen with a man on it while asking James if he had screenshots of the virtual world he made.

On 2022-04-20, James shared a photo of a woman dressed in armor kneeling on a rock, a screenshot of the game character he created; he said it was a lot of work but rewarding and super satisfying when it came together. He had no screenshot of the full virtual world.

James got the idea for his game character from a walk with his dogs around his neighborhood about two weeks before 2022-04-20 (around 2022-04-06), when he saw a stranger woman he had never seen nearby before; her eyes and appearance amazed him and it felt like love at first sight. He regrets not approaching her but remembered her appearance and embodied it in the game.

On 2022-04-18 (two days before 2022-04-20), John found a canyon in the surrounding area and shared a photo of a river running through it surrounded by mountains; he described the view as very calming.
John said capturing the canyon view was amazing, like connecting the real and the imaginary, and it sparked his creativity and motivation.
John remarked that real-life experiences can be inspiring and that the virtual world is connected to the real world.
James noted that John's canyon experience was cool and that he bet John felt inspired seeing it in person.
James asked John what else gives him motivation.
John adheres to the principle that only those who rest well work well; chilling with friends and traveling give him motivation to work further.
James loves to travel.
James visited Italy in 2021; he described it as a very beautiful country with delicious food.
James said he hasn't visited many countries; besides Italy, he has also been to Turkey and Mexico.
John has always dreamed of visiting Italy.
John has visited Japan; he finds the country's megacities impressive, everything technologically advanced, and the huge screens on buildings mesmerizing, plus the street food very tasty.
On 2022-04-20 John shared a photo of a busy city street at night with people walking, which he said was Japan.
James proposed that he and John go somewhere together next year (2023); John agreed, saying he hopes everything works out and he will believe in it.
James will start looking for a country where he and John can travel together next year (2023); John asked James to keep him posted and offered help if needed.
John is impressed by technologically advanced megacities with huge screens on buildings and by tasty street food; Japan is an example he cites.
James went on a hike with his two dogs on 2022-04-21, exploring nice trails and enjoying fresh air.
James shared a photo on 2022-04-23 of a man walking two dogs on a path in the woods.
James chose the hiking spot because it had great views and lots of trails, perfect for his dogs to explore nature, with lush greenery and clean air.
James loves hearing the crunch of leaves under his feet and the peacefulness of nature; it helps him clear his head and chill.
John wishes he could spend more time in nature and feels he needs chill vibes because things have been crazy for him lately.
John has been super busy at work with deadlines all over the place; it has been really hectic lately.
John is frustrated and stuck on a difficult coding assignment involving a complex new algorithm he is trying to make work better, and feels he is getting nowhere.

James advised John that breaking the algorithm problem down into smaller steps, researching similar algorithms, and asking other programmers for advice could help, and said not to be afraid to seek help because every problem has a solution.
John agreed to try breaking his coding problem into smaller steps and asking for help, and thanked James for the advice.
James told John he was glad to help and encouraged him, saying John would find the answer if he kept going.
John shared a photo of a notebook with a quote written on it.
John told James that James's words really helped him, and that he won't quit his coding assignment and will keep going.
John plans to keep going with his coding assignment and not quit.
On 29 April 2022 John told James he is taking on freelance programming work to hone his coding skills.
John's first professional programming project outside of class is a website for a local small business.
John's freelance website project is progressing slowly, with hiccups; the toughest challenge was figuring out how to get payments on the website, which he solved using outside resources.
John says he has learned a lot from the freelance project and is determined to keep pushing through hiccups; he appreciated James's encouragement.
James told John hiccups are normal in projects, to use them to learn and grow, and to push through.
On 26 April 2022 (three days before the 29 April 2022 chat) James bought an adventure book containing fantasy novels and cool art.
James shared a photo of a person holding a book open to a picture of a male character, from his new adventure book of fantasy novels.
At 2:36 pm on 2022-04-29, John complimented James's shared fantasy-book art, saying it took John back to reading fantasy books.
James said he loves the fantasy genre and asked John for book suggestions on 2022-04-29.
On 2022-04-29, John recommended the novel 'The Name of the Wind' to James, calling it another great novel with awesome writing.
James had never heard of 'The Name of the Wind' before 2022-04-29; James said it sounded interesting and thanked John for the recommendation.
James planned to check out John's recommended novel 'The Name of the Wind'.
On 2022-04-29, James shared a photo of a book set of three books on a wooden table.
John said he was always happy to help and was sure James would love the trilogy.
Daisy is James's dog.
On 2022-04-29, James was playing a game when his dog Daisy came and lay down next to him.
On 2022-04-29, James shared a photo of his dog Daisy lying on a bed with a computer in the background.
John thought the photo of James's dog was really cute and said the dog looked cozy.
On 2022-04-29, John asked James whether James's dogs often come to him while James is playing games.
James's dogs love to watch James gaming and often hug him; James calls them good cuddle buddies.
On 2022-04-29, James asked John what game John has been playing lately.
On 2022-04-29, James shared a photo of a person holding a blue controller in their hand.
On 2022-04-29, John told James he was currently playing Assassin's Creed Valhalla and thought it was cool.
On 2022-04-29, John asked James if he was playing anything new.
On 2022-04-29, James thanked John, said Valhalla is awesome, and said he was trying out strategy games; he shared a photo of a map of the world on a TV screen, calling the game different but cool.
On 2022-04-29, John asked if the game James shared was Civilization VI and asked how it was.

On 2022-04-29, James shared a photo of a computer screen showing a game of war and described the game as a high-quality turn-based strategy game where you manage resources, lead armies, and conquer territories; he called it challenging and cool.
On 2022-04-29, John said the game sounded fun and asked what it was like and whether it required a lot of strategy.
On 2022-04-29, James said the strategy game requires a lot of strategy, is about planning, managing resources, and making good decisions to beat rivals, and that every move matters.
On 2022-04-29, John said the game sounded intense but cool and that he likes games that test his strategizing; he asked whether it helps with problem-solving.
On 2022-04-29, James said the strategy game is a great way to work on problem-solving and thinking, and that it is awesome to see plans go as wanted and win.
On 2022-04-29, John agreed it is satisfying when plans work out and you win, and asked how long James had been playing the game.
As of 2022-04-29, James had been playing the strategy game for a month, and it had challenged his strategy skills.

On 2022-04-29, John said he was really enjoying games like that because they make him think; he asked James what he thought of strategy board games and said he had played one with friends two days earlier (2022-04-27), which was very exciting, and shared a photo of a board game with a lot of cards.
On 2022-04-29, James said board games are always a blast when you hang out with friends.
On 2022-04-29, John agreed board games are great for having fun together.
On 2022-04-29, James asked what else is fun to play with others.

On 2022-04-29, John told James about a card game he played with friends but forgot the name of: it has multi-colored cards with numbers, you place a card on your opponent's card only if it matches in color or number, players sometimes trade cards, sometimes draw extra cards from the deck or skip a turn.
The card game John described on 2022-04-29 (multi-colored numbered cards, matching color or number, trading, drawing extra cards, skipping turns) matches the rules of UNO.
James did not recognize the card game John described on 2022-04-29 and asked John for other interesting game suggestions.
On 2022-04-29 John told James he has been playing a social deduction game with friends (players try to figure out who the impostors are), which he finds super fun.
John recommends the impostor/social deduction game and advises gathering a large group because it is much more interesting to play that way.
James said he had heard of the impostor game and has been meaning to try it out; he agreed it sounds like fun.

On 2022-05-04, James told John that on the previous Friday (2022-04-29) he hit a major snag in a project he had been working on for weeks: a bug in the code messed up the game mechanics. He tried debugging it for hours but couldn't solve it alone, which was super frustrating and disappointing.
After James couldn't fix the bug in his game project on his own, a group of friends teamed up with him and got it fixed, taking a bit of work. He was glad it got done.

James believes it's awesome to have a group of people who share the same passions, because they help you and bring their own ideas to the mix, and that you can achieve so much when everyone works together.
records.topic: value of teamwork and shared passions

records.text: John thinks having a reliable team can really make a difference, and that it's important to balance work and enjoyment.
On 2022-05-04, John had a day off and invited a few new friends over to watch some movies. He said he is trying to socialize more and that it's been great.
John invited James to join him and his friends for a future movie night; James said he is definitely in next time.
On 2022-05-04, James spent time with his beloved pets again and shared a photo of two dogs playing in a fenced-in area (presumably Daisy and Ned).
James enjoys hanging out with friends and unwinding, calling it key.

John and James discussed James's pets; John said the pets in the photo looked like they were having a blast and asked what type they were. James said Daisy is a Labrador and confirmed the other two are shepherds.
James has a dog named Daisy, who is a Labrador.
Daisy the Labrador loves to play with her toys, but most of all she loves to eat.
James has two other pets besides Daisy, and they are shepherds; James says they are very loyal and that loyalty is their main feature.
James says that his pets, computer games, travel, and pizza are the things that bring him happiness in life.
John loves pizza and said his favorite pizza is Hawaiian, which he likes for its sweet and salty combination.
James's favorite pizza is pepperoni, which he described as an amazing combination of spicy salami and cheese.
John shared a photo of a pizza with pineapples and ham on a wooden board.
James also likes cheese pizza and prosciutto pizza.
John has not tried prosciutto pizza yet but has heard it is great.
On 2022-05-04, James encouraged John to try prosciutto, saying it is really great and promising no regrets.
On 2022-05-04, John agreed to try prosciutto and said he would check it out. James asked John to tell them his impressions after he tries it and said 'Bon Appetit!'
On 2022-05-04, John thanked James and said 'Catch you later,' ending their conversation.
On 2022-05-08 at 12:45 am, James messaged John, apologized for not replying sooner, and asked how John was and whether he was into any new games.
John told James on 2022-05-08 that he had been organizing something with his friends the previous day (2022-05-07), and shared a photo of a wooden table with a game controller on it.
John organized a CS:GO tournament with his friends on 2022-05-07; many people showed up and they raised a bunch of money for charity.
John said organizing the CS:GO charity tournament took planning and coordination but was definitely worth it; seeing everyone come together for a good cause was rewarding.
John wants to organize more gaming charity events in the future because it combines his interests, helps the community, and brings people together for friendly competition.
The main goal of John's CS:GO charity tournament was to raise money for a dog shelter not far from the street where John lives, and they succeeded.
After helping the dog shelter, John and his friends used leftover money to buy groceries and cook food for homeless people, who were very happy about it.
James said helping animals is really important and told John he was doing a great job, was proud of him, and encouraged him to keep up the good work.
James had been busy at work, which John acknowledged when James apologized for the delayed reply.
On 2022-05-11 at 5:00 pm, John told James he had recently volunteered his programming skills for a social cause and created a software tool for a charitable foundation to streamline its operations.

On 2022-05-11, John described to James that the charitable foundation previously used paper records and manual inventory, and John created an application that structured their work and put all inventory needs into one smartphone application.

On 2022-05-11, John shared a photo with James: a photo of a computer monitor showing the CPU performance of a computer; John described his system as making tracking of inventory, resources, and donations smoother and generating reports for analysis.
John said the charitable foundation he made software for is passionate about helping kids, which inspired him to contribute.
John said coding lets him challenge himself and expand his skills, and that using his coding skills for the foundation was really rewarding.
John said the volunteering experience showed him the power of tech to make positive changes beyond personal enjoyment and gave him a real sense of purpose.

On 2022-05-11, John said the experience motivated him to use his programming skills for positive impact and that he is now considering volunteer roles and potentially a career in the non-profit sector.
On 2022-05-11, James reacted supportively to John's volunteer programming work, said it was awesome and inspiring, and asked to hear more and see visual examples of the impact.

On 2022-05-11, James asked John what motivated him, how the experience affected him, how it would impact his future plans, and whether John had found non-profit organizations that align with his values and programming passion.

On 2022-05-11 at 5:00 pm, John told James that he had not yet found the volunteer/non-profit organization he was looking for and had not looked for it, but he thought it would not be difficult to find the organization he needed.
James told John on 2022-05-11 that there are lots of places where John can show off his skills and that James is sure John will find one perfect for making a difference.
On 2022-05-11, John said he would be happy to find a place where his skills and passions are a perfect match, and he hopes to make a positive impact there.
On 2022-05-11, James told John he was sure John would find the right spot and that John's skills and passions would be a great addition; James wished John good luck.
On 2022-05-11, John thanked James and said James's encouragement meant a lot; James replied that he was there for John and wished him good luck again.
On 2022-05-11, John thanked James again, said he appreciated it, and told James to take care and talk soon.
On the weekend of 2022-05-21 to 2022-05-22, James went to an amusement park with his friends and had an awesome time; it was a great break from the virtual world.
At the amusement park, James rode roller coasters, a Ferris wheel, electric cars, and buggies; the roller coasters reminded him of childhood and felt real and exciting, like being in a video game.
John replied to James that the amusement park sounded like an awesome time and asked whether there were other attractions besides the roller coaster.
James told John he also rode the Ferris wheel, electric cars, and buggies at the amusement park, then asked John what was new with him.
James enjoys amusement parks and roller coasters; he found the real, exciting rides nostalgic and compared the experience to a video game.
John entered a local tournament on Friday 2022-05-20 and took second place; the competitive energy was insane and it was a wild experience.
James congratulated John on his tournament second place and asked if he received rewards or prizes.
John received money for second place in the tournament even though he didn't win; seeing his effort pay off was awesome and he was stoked about the achievement.
James told John you don't have to win every time; growth and progress are most important.
John received a trophy for his tournament second place; it is satisfying and reminds him to always put in his best effort.
John shared a photo of a graduation cap on a book with a rope.

James had a personal milestone in April 2022: after tough times he felt a huge sense of accomplishment and readiness for future opportunities; he congratulated John and said John's trophy looks awesome.
James finished a big project he had been working on for months (completed around April 2022); it was challenging because he had to learn a new language and handle many details.
James learned a lot about problem-solving, patience, and perseverance from his big project and now feels more confident to take on even bigger projects.

John praised James for learning a language and handling all the details, told him determination and confidence make any project a success, and said he's here to help and to keep going and reach his goals.
James thanked John for his support and said he'll keep John's advice in mind.
John got an offer for his dream job after many interviews and late nights, and he was ecstatic about it.
John will start his new dream job in July 2022 (next month from 2022-06-13).
James recently started a course that combines his passion for gaming and programming; he finds it fun and challenging and it increased his excitement for both.
James congratulated John on the dream job and is super stoked for him; he advised John not to be afraid to seek help when starting out.
John thinks combining gaming and coding sounds like a dream and asked James about interesting projects he is working on.
On 2022-06-13, James was working on a new part of a football simulator and had collected player databases; he said it was not easy but he did it.
records.topic: James's gaming and programming course project

records.text: John asked James whether he chose his course because he loves football.
records.topic: James's reasons for taking the gaming and programming course

records.text: James said he chose his gaming and programming course partly because he loves football, but the most important reason was to improve himself; he likes it when a course is connected to something he enjoys.
records.topic: James's reasons for taking the gaming and programming course

records.text: James loves football.
On 2022-06-13 at 4:30 pm, John asked James if James had watched the Liverpool vs Chelsea match.

James watched the Liverpool vs Chelsea match and supports Liverpool FC; James says there is no sport better than football and no club better than Liverpool, and James does not miss a single Liverpool match.
James said Liverpool FC are forever in James's heart and are a great team; James hopes Liverpool become champions in the 2022-23 season.
John supports Manchester City FC.
John predicted Manchester City and Liverpool will fight for the championship and Manchester City will win.
James said Manchester City are in bad form and Manchester City's transfer policy is terrible; John replied that the Manchester City manager can handle it.
James bet John that Liverpool will finish higher than Manchester City in the final standings in the 2022-23 season; John accepted the bet and called it a great battle.
